2026_05_PHI_JAX.headline: Jacksonville defense meets Philadelphia's reshuffled lineup in London
2026_05_PHI_JAX.paragraph1: Jacksonville enters its London game with a strong defense and a productive Trevor Lawrence passing attack. Philadelphia will be without Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith, while several changes along the offensive line increase the importance of quick decisions from Jalen Hurts. Dallas Goedert returns to offer a short-range receiving option, and linebacker Zack Baun is available again on defense. The Jaguars can challenge Philadelphia's protection with their front four, but Lawrence must protect the ball against the Eagles' secondary. Third-down efficiency and field position should decide the contest.
2026_05_PHI_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville can challenge the Eagles' altered protection while preserving coverage. Philadelphia needs reliable short passes and defensive stops to keep the Jaguars from controlling possession.
